services.helpLegendSubtitle: Quick guide to admin controls and icons:
services.helpGlobalDesc: Use the top gear button to toggle category renaming, reordering (⋮⋮), AI category pictogram generation, and variant column header editing (e.g. Short / Long hair).
services.helpRowDesc: Tap the gear icon on the right side of any service row to expand its dedicated editor card—making it easy to edit names, prices, and durations even with a mobile keyboard.
services.helpDurationDesc: Sets how many minutes the online booking calendar and timeline slider reserve for this treatment by default (in 5-minute increments).
services.helpBookableDesc: When turned off, the item stays visible on the public price list (e.g. Important Info, Surcharges) but cannot be selected in the online booking wizard.
services.helpTranslateDesc: Tap the sparkles (✨) button to automatically translate the category or service name and description into the currently active language.
services.helpRecipeDesc: Configure which inventory products (e.g. hair dye, developer) are used by default when performing this treatment.
services.helpModifierDesc: In the category header (when Page Settings mode is on), you can configure a variant to automatically update the client's profile attribute upon booking (e.g. Hair Length -> Long).

modifierModal.title: Automatic Profile Update
modifierModal.description: When a client books this variant, their profile attributes will automatically be updated with the values below.
modifierModal.noAttributes: Create attributes first in Settings > Client Attributes!
modifierModal.emptyPlaceholder: Leaving blank will make no changes

gallery.helpLegendSubtitle: Guide to managing photos and folders safely on mobile and desktop
gallery.helpGlobalDesc: By default, the gallery is locked against accidental dragging so you can scroll and browse freely on your phone. Turn on Page Settings at the top to create folders, upload photos, rename folders, or reorder items.
gallery.helpImageTitle: Individual Image Settings (⚙️ button on photo)
gallery.helpImageDesc: Tap the ⚙️ button in the top-right corner of any photo to open its settings modal, where you can edit its caption, translate it with AI, move it to another folder, or delete it.
gallery.helpDragDesc: Photos can only be dragged when Page Settings is active, using the ✥ handle in the top-left corner of the photo. Touching the photo itself will always safely scroll the page or open the lightbox.
gallery.helpUploadDesc: High-resolution photos from your phone are automatically optimized before upload for fast loading and minimal data usage.
